lines: Jhoom liya, naara-e-mastaana bhi bana
couplets.en: I swayed and became a cry of rapture.

lines: Deewana jo banaya to main deewana bhi bana
couplets.en: When you drove me mad, I gave myself to madness.

lines: Nigaah-e-yaar ne hi mujh ko deewana banaya
couplets.en: The beloved's gaze alone drove me mad.

lines: Raunaq-e-duniya aur gham se begaana banaya
couplets.en: The world's glitter and its grief fell away.

lines: Sar-e-mehfil jo ek tamaasha lagaya
couplets.en: You made a spectacle before the whole gathering.

lines: Meri nazron mein jo khud ko basaya
couplets.en: You made your home in my eyes.

lines: Dar-e-yaar pe jis ne Bullhe Shah ko nachaya
couplets.en: You made Bullhe Shah dance at the beloved's door.

lines: Bullhe Shah ko nachaya
couplets.en: You made Bullhe Shah dance.

lines: Jab maanga deedaar to Koh-e-Toor jalaya
couplets.en: When I asked to see you, you set Mount Sinai ablaze.

lines: Koh-e-Toor jalaya
couplets.en: You set Mount Sinai ablaze.

lines: Haq pe hoon to faazil hoon
couplets.en: My only distinction is to stand with Truth.

lines: Hans ke main jaan de doon
couplets.en: I would give my life with a smile.

lines: Kaheen Sarmad, kaheen Mansoor
couplets.en: Here is Sarmad, there is Mansoor.

lines: La-haasil ka woh haasil hoon
couplets.en: I am what is found when nothing can be gained.

lines: Ki jo hasrat ke, ki jo hasrat ke, ki jo hasrat ke mujh ko tamaasha na bana
couplets.en: I only wished you would spare me the crowd's gaze.

lines: Sar-e-baazaar jo, sar-e-baazaar jo nachaya to ab hosh mein na la
couplets.en: You made me dance in the marketplace, so let me stay beside myself.

lines: Saaghar ki aarzoo hai
couplets.en: I long for the goblet.

lines: Haan, saaghar ki aarzoo hai, ab tu paimaana na thama
couplets.en: Yes, I long for the goblet, so spare me the measuring cup.

lines: Hauz-e-Kausar pe bula, mujhe be-hisaab pila
couplets.en: Call me to the pool of Kausar and let me drink without measure.
